metadata.description: XeoMatrix skills for building Tableau Next / Data 360 semantic models as code.

plugins.name: tableau-next-semantics
plugins.description: Pro-code toolkit for Tableau Next semantic models: bulk field/table descriptions, relationships and cardinality (Many-to-One comes from the load-time primary key), geographic roles, and the retrieve/validate/deploy loop. Tunes models for Tableau Pulse and Agentforce.
